data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'patricius', meaning 'patriarch' or 'nobleman'. In the Roman Republic, a patrician was a member of the highest social class, often holding political and religious power. The name Patrizius carries the meaning “Patriarch, nobleman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Patrizius usually hope their child will grow to embody patriarch, nobleman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
